title: bicuculla ochroleuca
intro: Bicuculla ochroleuca, commonly known as the yellow gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the gentian family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Bicuculla ochroleuca include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce nausea and vomiting, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
